elements.title: Firecracker VM Escape: PwnEscape Part 2.
elements.contents: A malicious guest crossed Firecracker's microVM boundary, resolved the live VMM from inside the VM, and took control of a root-run host process—turning a Linux networking flaw into a guest-to-host code-execution primitive.

elements.title: CVE-2026-106378: Chrome GPU Sandbox Escape to RCE
elements.contents: How an allowed WindowServer connection and inherited macOS event-posting permission let Chrome’s sandboxed GPU process inject keystrokes and launch apps outside the sandbox.

elements.title: Inside the Sandbox: How pwn Escaped Google kvmCTF (Before the Watershed)
elements.contents: Before sandbox escapes became one of AI security’s loudest conversations, pwn spent weeks inside nested KVM, built a 14,338-line exploit harness, and made Google’s live kvmCTF host return the flag. This is the story of what happened inside the sandbox.

elements.title: Click2Shell: Preauth WordPress Core Theme Preview Injection to  RCE Chain
elements.contents: A pre-authentication Theme Injection to RCE chain in WordPress Core that allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution on any default WordPress installation through a single click.

elements.title: XSS2Shell: WordPress Preauth XSS to RCE Chain (CVE-2026-64638)
elements.contents: A pre-authentication XSS to RCE chain in WordPress Core that allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution on any default WordPress installation through the login page.

elements.title: CVE-2026-14077: Select Your Own Origin - Spoofing Chrome's Address Bar
elements.contents: How one HTML select crossed Chrome's line of death and turned a single click into a spoofed, convincing fake software-download flow.

elements.title: The Search for AGI through Security: Introducing the World's First AI-Based Novel Attack Vector Researcher
elements.contents: We believe one of the clearest paths toward AGI is automating one of the hardest knowledge-worker roles in cybersecurity: the researcher who discovers novel attack vectors before the industry has language for them.

elements.title: ImageMagick: From Arbitrary File Read to RCE In Every Policy
elements.contents: How pwn.ai turned a routine client pentest into multiple ImageMagick exploits. By autonomously researching the product’s internals for days, it found a path from a single image upload to file leaks, security policy bypasses, and remote code execution across a wide range of default and real-world configurations.

elements.title: CVE-2025-54322 (ZERODAY) - Unauthenticated Root RCE affecting ~70,000+ Hosts
elements.contents: A critical zero-day vulnerability, CVE-2025-54322, has been discovered that enables Unauthenticated Root Remote Command Execution (RCE) in devices running Xspeeder's SXZOS firmware. These networking devices, primarily edge routers and SD-WAN appliances, are extensively used, resulting in an estimated 30,000+ hosts being publicly exposed to full system compromise. The vulnerability was autonomously discovered by the pwn.ai platform. This public disclosure follows six months of unsuccessful attempts to notify the vendor, Xspeeder. The technical findings reveal that the exploit bypasses several superficial defenses, including an Nginx user-agent check and a custom Django GateKeeper middleware that attempts to restrict access using a time-sensitive header nonce and session checks.
